title: Quince Therapeutics, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-22
summary: Quince Therapeutics, Inc. (ticker: QNCX, listed on Nasdaq Global Select Market) filed an 8-K on April 22, 2026 reporting the appointment of June Bray as a Class I director to fill a vacancy created by the board's expansion to four members. Ms. Bray was designated as independent and appointed to the Nominating & Governance, Audit, and Compensation Committees.
key_points: Board expanded from three to four members; June Bray appointed as new Class I director effective April 22, 2026
Ms. Bray designated as independent under Nasdaq listing standards
Ms. Bray will receive $38,000 annual retainer for board service plus $7,500 (Nominating & Governance), $5,500 (Audit), and $4,000 (Compensation) committee retainers
Ms. Bray will not receive an initial option grant; standard indemnification agreement applies
Company is headquartered in South San Francisco, California; registered in Delaware; ticker QNCX on Nasdaq Global Select Market
